verses.text: Haton yab'ixal yinhtilal winhaj Esaú, Edom pax sb'i.
Ix yik'laj sb'a winhaj Esaú yet' heb' ix aj Canaán: Haton yet' ix Ada, yisil winhaj Elón hitita yet' pax ix Aholibama yisil winhaj Aná, yixchikin winhaj Zibeón heweo.
Ix yik'anpax ix Basemat winh, ix yisil winhaj Ismael. Ay jun winh snulej ix Basemat chi' skuchan Nebaiot.
Ha yune' ix Ada yet' winhaj Esaú, haton winhaj Elifaz. Axo pax ix Basemat ix alji yune' ix, haton winhaj Reuel.
Axo pax ix Aholibama ix alji heb' yune' ix: Haton winhaj Jeús, winhaj Jaalam yet' winhaj Coré. Haton heb' yuninal winhaj Esaú tik ix aj t'a yol yik Canaán, ayik kajantoek' winh ta'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'anb'at heb' ix yetb'eyum winhaj Esaú chi' yet' heb' yuninal yet' masanil heb' kajanek' yet'ok. Ix b'at heb' t'a junxo lugar, yik tz'el winh t'a stz'ey winhaj Jacob, winh yuk'tak. Ix yik'anel masanil nok' smolb'etzal nok' winh t'a Canaán chi'.
Yujto tzijtumxo tas ay t'a heb' winh schawanhil, yuj chi' max yal-laj junnhej tz'aj heb' winh, yujto max yab'laj lum lum b'aj swa nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb' winh.
Yuj chi' ix b'at winhaj Esaú chi', ix b'at kajnaj winh t'a tzalkixtak t'a yol yik Seir.
Haton tik yab'ixal heb' yinhtilal winhaj Esaú, haton heb' smam yicham heb' winh edomita, heb' winh ix kajnajek' t'a tzalkixtak t'a Seir.
Haton sb'i heb' yinhtilal winhaj Esaú: Winhaj Elifaz, yune' ix Ada, winhaj Reuel yune' ix Basemat.
Haton heb' tik yuninal winhaj Elifaz: Winhaj Temán, winhaj Omar, winhaj Zefo, winhaj Gatam yet' winhaj Cenaz.
Ay jun ix schab'il yetb'eyum winhaj Elifaz chi', Timna sb'i ix. Ix alji jun yune' ix, Amalec ix yak' ix sb'iej. Haton heb' tik yixchikin ix Ada, ix yetb'eyum winhaj Esaú.
Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Reuel: Winhaj Nahat, winhaj Zera, winhaj Sama yet' winhaj Miza, haton heb' tik yixchikin ix Basemat, junxo ix yetb'eyum winhaj Esaú.
Aholibama sb'i junxo ix yetb'eyum winhaj Esaú chi', haxo heb' yune' ix haton winhaj Jeús, winhaj Jaalam yet' winhaj Coré. Ha ix Aholibama chi' yisil ix winhaj Aná, yixchikin winhaj Zibeón.

Ha heb' yajalil chonhab' ix el t'a skal yinhtilal winhaj Esaú, haton heb' tik: Ha heb' ix el t'a yinhtilal winhaj Elifaz, b'ab'el yuninal winhaj Esaú: Haton winhaj Temán, winhaj Omar, winhaj Zefo, winhaj Cenaz,
winhaj Coré, winhaj Gatam yet' winhaj Amalec. Ha juntzanh heb' winh yajal tik ix el t'a yinhtilal winhaj Elifaz t'a yol yik Edom. Masanil juntzanh heb' winh tik, yixchikin heb' winh ix Ada.

Ha t'a skal heb' yuninal winhaj Reuel yuninal winhaj Esaú, a heb' ix och yajalilok chonhab': Haton winhaj Nahat, winhaj Zera, winhaj Sama yet' winhaj Miza. Ha heb' yajal tik ix el t'a yinhtilal winhaj Reuel t'a yol yik Edom. Masanil juntzanh heb' winh tik, yixchikin heb' winh ix Basemat yetb'eyum winhaj Esaú.
Ha heb' yune' ix Aholibama yisil winhaj Aná, yetb'eyum winhaj Esaú, ix och yajalilok chonhab': Haton winhaj Jeús, winhaj Jaalam yet' winhaj Coré.
Masanil juntzanh heb' winh yajal tik, yinhtilal heb' winhaj Esaú.
Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Seir horeo, a heb' kajan t'a jun lugar chi' ayik manto k'och winhaj Esaú: Haton winhaj Lotán, winhaj Sobal, winhaj Zibeón, winhaj Aná,
winhaj Disón, winhaj Ezer yet' winhaj Disán. Haton heb' tik yajalil chonhab' t'a skal heb' horeo, heb' yinhtilal Seir, t'a yol yik Edom.
Axo heb' yuninal winhaj Lotán, haton heb' tik: Winhaj Hori yet' winhaj Hemam. Timna sb'i ix yanab' winhaj Lotán chi'.
Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Sobal, haton heb' tik: Winhaj Alván, winhaj Manahat, winhaj Ebal, winhaj Sefo yet' winhaj Onam.
Eb' yuninal winhaj Zibeón, haton winhaj Aja yet' winhaj Aná. Ayik ix stanhwan nok' sb'uru winh smam winhaj Aná chi' t'a tzinan lu'um, ix ilchaj jun sjaj ha ha' yuj winh.
Axo winhaj Aná chi', ay jun yuninal winh skuchan Disón, ay pax jun ix yisil winh skuchan Aholibama.
Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Disón, haton heb' tik: Winhaj Hemdán, winhaj Esbán, winhaj Itrán yet' winhaj Querán.
Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Ezer, haton heb' tik: Winhaj Bilhán, winhaj Zaaván yet' winhaj Acán.
Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Disán, haton winhaj Uz yet' winhaj Arán.
Ha heb' yajalil chonhab' t'a skal heb' horeo t'a yol yik Seir, haton heb' tik: Winhaj Lotán, winhaj Sobal, winhaj Zibeón, winhaj Aná, winhaj Disón, winhaj Ezer yet' winhaj Disán.
Haton heb' winh tik ix yak' yajalil t'a Edom, ayik mantalaj sreyal heb' israel.
Ha winhaj Bela, yuninal winhaj Beor aj Dinaba, ix yak' reyal winh t'a Edom.
Ayik ix cham winh, ix ochkan winhaj Jobab yuninal winhaj Zera aj Bosra reyal sk'exulok winh.
Ayik ix cham winhaj Jobab chi', haxo winhaj Husam aj Temán, ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh.
Ayik ix cham winhaj Husam chi', haxo winhaj Hadad yuninal winhaj Bedad aj chonhab' Awit ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh. Haton winh ix ak'an ganar heb' aj Madián t'a yol yik Moab.
Ayik ix cham winhaj Hadad chi', haxo winhaj Samla aj Masreca ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh.
Ayik ix cham winhaj Samla chi', haxo winhaj Saúl aj chonhab' Rehobot ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh. Ha jun chonhab' Rehobot chi', ha t'a sti' ha' niwan Éufrates ay.
Ayik ix cham winhaj Saúl chi', haxo winhaj Baal-hanán yuninal winhaj Acbor ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh.
Ayik ix cham winhaj Baal-hanán chi', haxo winhaj Hadad aj Pau ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh. Axo ix yetb'eyum winhaj Hadad chi', Mehetabel sb'i ix, yune' ix ix Matred, yixchikin winhaj Mezaab.

Haton sb'i heb' yajalil chonhab' ix el t'a yinhtilal winhaj Esaú tik: Winhaj Timna, winhaj Alwa, winhaj Jetet, winhaj Aholibama, winhaj Ela, winhaj Pinón, winhaj Cenaz, winhaj Temán, winhaj Mibzar, winhaj Magdiel yet' winhaj Iram. Anhejtona' a sb'i heb' ix och t'a junjun lugar b'aj ix ek' heb'. Ha winhaj Esaú chi' Edom pax sb'i winh, haton smam yicham heb' edomita.
